title: A trace formula derivation of the functional equation for symmetric square L-functions
summary: This paper revisits the functional equation of the symmetric-square $L$-function from the perspective of trace formulas. We show that, for level-one holomorphic cusp forms and even Hecke--Maass cusp forms, this symmetry can be recovered directly from the Petersson and Kuznetsov trace formulas. Although the functional equation itself is classical, our aim is to provide a concrete and transparent example of how the analytic structure of an $L$-function can emerge from a comparison of the spectral and geometric sides of a trace formula.
